info.title: Box Universal API
info.description: Connect Box to search content, inspect the authenticated user, and work with files and folders through the Box API.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

sessionId.description: Upload session ID returned by Create Upload Session.

wholeFileSha1.description: The complete file in base64, the same value the parts were sliced from. Box needs a checksum of the whole file to close the upload and this action works it out for you. A 40-character hexadecimal SHA-1 is also accepted if you already have one.

parts.description: List of part objects returned by Upload Part, ordered by offset.
